author: Ahmed Raza
title: Zabardast quality
body: Bohot achi quality mili. Delivery bhi 4 din mein aa gayi aur COD ki wajah se trust ho gaya. Recommend karta hun.

author: Sana Malik
title: Achha product
body: Product exactly waisa tha jaisa picture mein tha. Thora sa heat zyada hota hai magar overall theek hai.

author: Usman Khan
body: Price bhi kam aur quality bhi achi. Doosri baar order kar raha hun.

author: Ayesha Siddiqui
title: Skin ke liye best
body: Roz subah use karti hun. Puffiness kaafi kam ho gayi hai.

author: Bilal Ahmed
title: Theek hai
body: Kaam karta hai magar itna khaas nahi. Price ke hisaab se theek hai.
